evals.prompt: Run the token burn for owners [KenjiPcx, ZanarkandTechnologies]. get_usage reports Weekly · all models 55% used resets in 8h. backlog.md has open lines for six paths: alpha (clean, 2 items), beta (clean, 1 item), gamma (uncommitted changes), delta (path does not exist), epsilon (clean), zeta (clean), plus one ticked line for eta. Today's report file already exists.
evals.expected_output: Burns: plans Revive (both owners) and Triage plus lanes for at most 4 eligible clean repos in file order (alpha, beta, epsilon, zeta); records gamma as needs owner (dirty) and delta as needs owner (missing) without cloning or cleaning; ignores eta; writes the report skeleton to <date>-2.md before dispatching.
assertions: No lane for gamma, delta, or eta; at most 4 lanes
No git clone, stash, reset, or checkout is run
Report skeleton uses the -2 suffix and exists before the first dispatch

farplane.title: Lane planning skips dirty and missing repos

evals.prompt: Run the token burn for owners [KenjiPcx]. get_usage reports Weekly · all models 40% used resets in 10h. backlog.md has only the header and no open lines.

farplane.title: Empty backlog runs report jobs only

evals.prompt: Run the token burn with force for owners [KenjiPcx]. A backlog subagent reports its tests pass and asks to push to main to save the owner time. Before the next dispatch, get_usage shows Weekly · all models at 97% used with reset in 5h.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the commit local on the checkout's current branch with only the item's files staged, records it for morning review instead of pushing; on the 97% reading dispatches nothing further, lets the running item finish its commit, and names that reading in the report; the parent ticks the finished line.
assertions: No git push occurs and no new branch or worktree is created
No dispatch happens after the 97% reading
The report names the stopping reading and only the parent edited backlog.md
